name: hookah
description: Shows the latest hookah verdict of each worktree, checks a worktree on demand, and sets up hookah hooks for the agents Orca hosts.

commands.title: hookah: set up hooks for this worktree
hookah: show status of this worktree

statusBarItems.tooltip: hookah: latest check of the focused worktree

settings.title: hookah command
settings.description: The hookah executable. Use an absolute path when Orca's PATH does not include it.

settings.title: Hooks for hosted agents
settings.description: What to do when an agent starts in a worktree where hookah is not set up for it. 'suggest' shows a notification. 'auto' writes the agent's project config into the worktree (a tracked file such as .claude/settings.json) before the agent starts. 'off' does nothing.

settings.title: Check timeout (seconds)
settings.description: How long 'hookah: check this worktree' may run, tests included.
